Before you start

Check the eligibility criteria for Statutory Neonatal Care Pay.

What you’ll need

You’ll need the:

details of the company

details of the person responsible for dealing with the employee’s claim

employee’s details, including their National Insurance number and address

start date for the period that the employee is not eligible for Statutory Neonatal Care Pay, and the end date (if there is one)

Tell an employee

Get all of the information together before you start. You’ll fill this form in online and you cannot save your progress.

Start now
